text:
```yaml
name: OpenTherm V4.2 Specification Audit

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run ADR audit script
      run: npx @open-therm-group/otgw-firmware-tools adr-audit --adr-path docs/adr --output-file docs/adr/audit-report.md

    - name: Commit and push audit report
      run: |
        git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
        git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
        git add docs/adr/audit-report.md
        git commit -m "Update ADR audit report"
        git push origin main
```
